title: Instant Transmission
blurb: Two fingers to the forehead and Goku is simply somewhere else, having learned the technique from the Yardrats after dying, as one does. The meme usage maps perfectly onto any sudden departure: leaving a party without saying goodbye to anybody, exiting a conversation the moment it turns, becoming unavailable at the exact instant the bill arrives at the table. That zip means a person is no longer present and no further explanation will be offered. Faster than light, and considerably faster than an excuse.
origin: Goku's teleportation technique sound from Dragon Ball Z.
